notes.title: Update 1.2.1
notes.notes:
[h2]Bug Fixes[/h2]
[list]
[*] Fixed reincarnation accessories showing on the starting sheeper in the tutorial.
[*] Fixed not being able to hatch a new sheeper if the merchant is present while also having 9 other sheepers.
[/list]

notes.title: Update 1.2.0
notes.notes:
[h2]New Stuff[/h2]
[list]
[*] There is now a day/night cycle.
[*] Woofers will now only show up at night.
[*] During daytime, a traveling merchant may come to visit.
[*] The traveling merchant has some new exclusive items in stock!
[*] Added 1 new achievement.
[*] Fixed accessories not using the correct visual in the status window of an Anti Sheeper.
[/list]

notes.title: Update 1.1.0
notes.notes:
[h2]New Stuff[/h2]
[list]
[*] Accessories are now sold in the shop (requires membership)!
[list]
[*] All sheepers can wear any accessory.
[*] Sheepers can only wear one accessory at any given time.
[/list]
[*] The shop will no longer be able to sell multiple copies of the same colored egg at the same time.
[/list]

notes.title: Sheepers is now live!
notes.notes:
Today is the day to dive into the delightful world of [b]Sheepers[/b]! A free idle pet simulation game where you take on the charming challenge of raising and nurturing a vibrant flock of sheepers.

Feed and train your sheepers, then send them off to competitions to earn gold, allowing you to expand your farm and acquire even more colorful sheepers. Experiment with breeding to discover unique combinations, all while aiming to collect a sheep of each available color. The ultimate goal? Unveil the secret rainbow sheeper and achieve the pinnacle of your sheeper-raising journey. Sheepers is a blend of strategy, care, and discovery that will keep you engaged as you grow your own farm.

Also, players who own [b]Sea of Blood[/b] will also get the bonus of an exclusive sheeper egg (bought from the shop).

[b]Note:[/b] This requires the user to boot up the game at least once to take effect!

[b]Stay tuned for future updates![/b]
